description: This file defines a utility class 'SaveData' for handling file operations within an Android app, including reading, writing, and deleting files in internal storage.

classes.name: SaveData
classes.description: A utility class for managing simple file-based data storage within an Android application.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Saves a string to a file with the specified filename in internal storage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into the static variable 'content' and logs the contents.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified file from internal storage.
